description: This file defines a chat message model and a chat provider class managing chat state with mock data, including methods to initialize chat history and send messages.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: A simple model representing a chat message with an ID, sender, text, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing chat messages and state, supporting initialization and message sending, with optional mock data handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the chat history, loading mock data if enabled, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Creates a new chat message from user input, adds it to the message list, notifies listeners, and optionally generates a mock reply.
